newsitem.title: GREECE: PUBLIC PETROLEUM (DEP) HIKES GASOLINE PRICES THUR.
newsitem.headline: PUBLIC PETROLEUM (DEP) HIKES GASOLINE PRICES THUR.

text.p: Greek gasoline prices will be raised by 1.80 drachmas per litre but diesel prices will be lowered by 0.50 drachmas per litre, effective on Thursday and for one week, Greece's Public Petroleum Corporation (DEP) said in a statement.

The price adjustments come after higher world gasoline prices, up by $7.6 per metric tonne, lower diesel prices, down by $2.6 and a rise in the value of the dollar vis-a-vis the drachma by 0.70 drachmas. --George Georgiopoulos, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
